Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vishal Dhagat
 On The 15 th Of December, 2023
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 53426 of 2023

Gopal@ Appu S/O Lachhi Kushwaha, Aged About
 24 Years, Occupation: Labourer R/O Rani Bagh

Panna P.S. Kotwali Panna District Panna
 (Madhya Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri Pushpendra Dubey, Advocate )
 And
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through P.S.
 Kotwali Panna District Panna (Madhya
 Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri C. M. Tiwari, Govt. Advocate )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

1 . This is a first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant who is in jail since 15.5.2023 in connection with Crime No.335/2023, registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Panna for the offence punishable under Sections 342, 376(D) and 506 of the IPC and Section 5G/6 of POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
I n these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that is of ganj rape.
Prosecutrix has been gang raped by the applicant and other persons.
He relied on her statement given to police and also her statement recorded under section 164 CrPC.
